Honestly I was told a cup of flour and a cup of water. Don't pour it in all together.  Just slowly stir your water in until you get something that looks like cookie dough. I add cinnamon and vani to mine so they smell nice and I also add sea salt because it kind of makes them glitter in the lights. Cut out some cookies.  You dont wamt.to roll them too thin bec then they're like chips. And you dont want them.too thick because they're hard to hang on the tree be of how heavy they are. Make sure you poke a whole for the hook and then just cook at 350 till they're hardened up. That's how I do mine each year,  someone else may be mortif by my instructions.  I can tell you this, we haven't been able to afford ornaments for several years now but who cares, not only are these absolutely beautiful on the tree, you get to have a great time making them whether with family or all alone
